scope: Same producer with model absent / resident idle / exited; diagnostic only

method.order: Fixed absent-before / immediate /100ms settled / absent-after per rep;1 warmup +7 evaluations;3 producer calls each state
method.metrics: Raw producer counters and model process raw user+system ticks sampled immediately before/after child subprocess. Tick scale from producer Mach timebase. Parent process CPU measured separately.
method.excluded: Model load, real fixture task,100ms settle, model exit are outside producer window; stdout /dev/null throughout
method.limits: Only arithmetic producer, two shapes, fixed order temporal drift, no other process inventory; model CPU counts identify own background execution, not GPU execution or competitor PID.
